summary: Covered the v8 acceptance matrix (6 criteria: recoloured Super Hadouken beam per fighter, aura restricted to the charging fighter, strict serialization across different gift events, 2x speed/unit-damage for repeated same-user gifts, playback-rate-locked start/impact audio, and a pause/dispute/Fatality regression with the new queue) with 1 backend test file + 5 new browser checks, plus a reused persisted pause/dispute/Fatality check and the baseline public-ingress check. All 8 artifacts pass.

checks.criterion: Universo/Fatality usa o sprite fornecido em tamanho destrutivo, recolorido por lutador (sem expor a spritesheet crua)
checks.name: test_tscheck_universe_ultra_damage_per_unit (test_universe_gift_reports_240_damage_and_ultra_special_move)
checks.evidence: POST /api/live/demo/gift (gift_id=universe, qty=1) -> 200, damage=240, special_move=ultra_hadouken; same gift qty=2 -> 200, damage still 240 per unit (backend never inflates per-unit damage, only quantity). Cross-checked GET /api/live/events contains the created event.

checks.criterion: O Super Hadouken usa o sprite fornecido em tamanho destrutivo e recolorido por lutador
checks.name: ultra-beam-recolor-per-fighter-and-damage
checks.evidence: Zero ever in the DOM (canvas-only, cropped draw). Canvas-average colour bias during the projectile window: redBias=116.3 (Lula) and greenBias=13.3 (Flávio) vs pre-gift baseline, both well above threshold. HP dropped by exactly 240 on each side. Screenshot captured a clearly visible giant green Ultra beam for Flávio.

checks.criterion: A aura fornecida envolve somente quem carrega o Ultra
checks.name: ultra-aura-visible-only-during-charge
checks.evidence: Red-hue bias during the 0-900ms charge window peaked at 110.2 vs only 20.9 in the ~3.2-3.9s post-release window (move duration 1.7s), confirming the aura appears while charging and is gone well after release.

checks.criterion: As especiais de eventos diferentes são totalmente serializadas
checks.name: different-event-specials-fully-serialized
checks.evidence: Donut(Lula)->userA then Donut(Flávio)->userB queued back to back. userA's cutscene appeared and hid first; Flávio's HP had already dropped by 45 (userA's full Shoryuken completed) before userB's cutscene text appeared; userB's cutscene then hid and Lula's HP dropped by 45. No overlap at any point.

checks.criterion: Várias unidades da mesma pessoa aceleram toda a sequência sem mudar o dano
checks.name: same-user-multi-unit-2x-speed-and-damage
checks.evidence: 1x baseline cutscene (data-playback-speed=1) took 2810ms; Universo x2 from the same username showed data-playback-speed=2 and hid in 1318ms (well under half). HP dropped by exactly 480 (240/unit x2) off a fresh 600 HP bar, landing on 120/600 HP as specified.

checks.criterion: O áudio acelerado permanece preso aos quadros de início e impacto
checks.name: accelerated-audio-locked-to-start-and-impact
checks.evidence: Patched AudioBufferSourceNode.start/HTMLMediaElement.play to log playbackRate. Universo x2 (Lula) produced exactly 4 buffer-source plays, ALL at rate=2 (2 special-start + 2 special-impact cues for the 2 units); the last rate-2 event landed within 50ms of the confirmed -480 HP read, i.e. on the impact frame with no perceptible lag.

checks.criterion: Pausa, disputa 20/20 e Fatality continuam funcionando com a fila nova
checks.name: pause-dispute-fatality-still-working
checks.evidence: Re-ran existing persisted check: cutscene froze the timer-display; Heart x19 then x1 more for Lula hit 20/20, fatality-definitivo-banner fired, Flávio's HP went to 0, both ultra-red/blue scores reset to 0/20.

checks.criterion: Baseline regression: arena loads without login on the public ingress
checks.name: start-screen-opens-arena
checks.evidence: Re-ran against https://live-game-preview-1.preview.emergentagent.com; gameplay-screen visible, no login gate, no console errors.
